business_profile.competitive_position: Padma competes with other Dhaka diagnostic centres. An AI agent with real-time booking and automated report delivery would make them more responsive and reduce inbound status calls.
business_profile.opportunity_size: High patient volume means booking friction and report-status calls consume significant staff time. An AI booking + report-notification + recall agent recovers this and improves patient experience.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI booking agent with real-time confirmation.
2. Automated report-ready notifications.
3. Patient recall + follow-up.
4. Test enquiry handling with price guidance.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A patient books a blood test at 10pm via the AI agent and gets instant confirmation with a slot. When results are ready, the agent auto-notifies them. A 6-month recall is scheduled. Padma handled booking, delivery, and recall with zero staff calls.
